events.title: European Markets Close Higher For 2nd Straight Session
events.description: After two successive days of losses, European markets turned in a fine performance on Friday as geopolitical tensions eased after U.S. President Donald Trump said the U.S. will not attack Iran before next month's midterm elections and termed ongoing discussions with Tehran as "productive."

events.title: U.S. Consumer Sentiment Index Falls More Than Expected In October
events.description: Consumer sentiment in the U.S. has deteriorated by more than expected in the month of October, according to preliminary data released by the University of Michigan on Friday. The University of Michigan said its consumer sentiment index fell to 46.3 in October from 48.1 in September. Economists had expected the index to dip to 47.6.

events.title: Delta Stock Drops On Cautious Earnings View In Q4 & FY27 After Weak Q3
events.description: Shares of Delta Air Lines, Inc. were losing around 3 percent in the morning trading on the NYSE after the airline reported weak third-quarter earnings, issued cautious earnings view for the fourth quarter and trimmed fiscal 2027 earnings view amid high fuel cost environment.However, the company projects higher revenues for the fourth quarter, extending the strong third-quarter revenue performance.

events.title: Canadian Market Likely To Open On Mixed Note
events.description: It's likely to be a mixed start for stocks on Bay Street on Friday with investors tracking a mixed trend in the commodities markets and reacting to Canadian jobs data for the month of September.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Advances As Oil Drops; Miners Move Up
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 climbed higher Friday morning, supported by gains in mining and technology sectors. Lower crude oil prices and bond yields amid easing tensions about U.S.-Iran conflict lifted sentiment.

events.title: CAC 40 Modestly Higher As Oil Prices, Bond Yields Drop
events.description: France's equity benchmark CAC 40 was modestly higher a little past noon on Friday as stocks gained some ground in positive territory amid easing geopolitical tensions. Lower bond yields and crude oil prices also helped underpin sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares Rebound After Two-day Slide; IT Stocks Lead Gainers
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Friday, rebounding after two consecutive sessions of losses as oil prices fell and global bond yields steadied, helping ease concerns around inflation and interest rates.

events.title: German Equities Rally Amid De-Escalation Signals On Iran
events.description: Germany's DAX index surged 281.35 points to 25,088.32 on Friday after U.S. President Donald Trump stated the U.S. will not attack Iran before midterm elections and described Tehran discussions as productive. Brent crude fell nearly 1% to $103.23 a barrel, while German 10-year bond yields dropped to 3.484%.

events.title: Gold Rallies As Dollar Pauses, Yields Ease From 24-year Highs
events.description: Gold prices were sharply higher on Friday as oil prices fell and bond yields steadied, helping ease concerns around inflation and interest rates.

events.title: Oil Edges Lower After Trump Comments On Iran Talks
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Friday, trimming gains from the previous session as Middle East supply concerns eased somewhat in the wake of comments from U.S. President Donald Trump that the U.S. will not attack Iran before the midterm elections next month and that discussions with Tehran remain productive.

events.title: European Shares Surge After Trump Comments On Iran Talks
events.description: European stocks traded sharply higher on Friday, rebounding after two days of losses as oil prices slipped in the wake of comments from U.S. President Donald Trump that the U.S. will not attack Iran before the midterm elections next month and that discussions with Tehran remain productive.

events.title: Asian Shares Rise As Oil Prices And Bond Yields Dip
events.description: Asian stocks ended mostly higher in thin trade on Friday, with markets in South Korea and Taiwan closed for a holiday.
